title: AI Reader Design System
intro: A playful, friendly, and stress-free environment featuring organic rounded corners, soft shadows, and typography optimized for children's reading. Mobile-first, built in React Native with NativeWind.

primary.name: Pastel Purple
primary.usage: Primary brand color. Headings, main buttons, and virtual mascot interface

secondary.name: Soft Peach
secondary.usage: Playful accent color. Rewards, progress stars, and milestone achievements

gold.name: Amber Warm
gold.usage: In-progress words evaluated during read-aloud practice

card.name: Glass Surface
card.usage: Glassmorphism card surfaces containing reading passages

text.name: Charcoal Soft
text.usage: Primary story passage text (optimized for children's reading contrast)

textMuted.name: Slate Gray
textMuted.usage: Subtitles, Lexile text levels, and mascot guidance instructions

success.name: Success Green
success.usage: Words pronounced correctly with successful phonetic matching

error.name: Error Rose
error.usage: Mic issues or system errors (designed without intimidating visual penalties)

hierarchy.name: Story Heading
hierarchy.usage: Story title or current chapter headings

hierarchy.name: Reading Body
hierarchy.usage: Main reading text (Literata serif, 1.8 wide line height for child readability)

hierarchy.name: Lexile Level
hierarchy.usage: Lexile reading scale indicators and tutor dashboard metrics
